div.div: GCP is the Google Gemini slot in msrouter Base URL: generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai Default model: gemini-2.5-flash-lite, free tier via GEMINI_API_KEY. Order: unorouter, groq, sambanova, mistral, gemini, cline, cloudflare. Cloudflare is last in the walk; the local on-host slot comes first. The extras order is the facts.md EXTRA_PROVIDER_ORDER; the primary and local slots come from msrouter config, not facts.md. Pause switch (moves together): msrouter replicas 0 and finder FINDER_SCORING_ENABLED=false -> CvScorer fallback score 70; the score >= 60 CV filter stops rejecting and APPLY_MODE stays shadow.
